name: Dev Garg
tagline: I work on sign-in, infrastructure and AI features at Zime, a sales intelligence platform, and build small full-stack apps on the side.

tiles.label: Work
tiles.text: Sign-in and SSO, our Kubernetes setup on AWS, and Ask Zime, which answers questions about sales calls.

tiles.label: Ship
tiles.text: Apps I've put live: Kharcha for splitting expenses, a real-time project board, and my portfolio.

tiles.label: Stack
tiles.text: TypeScript and Java. NestJS, Next.js, React Native and Spring Boot, with Postgres and Redis on AWS.

repos.name: Kharcha
repos.description: Split expenses with friends or flatmates: group ledgers, live balances, settle-ups and exports. NestJS, Prisma and Redis.

repos.name: Project-Management-Dashboard
repos.description: A shared project board with roles for admins, managers and members. Tasks and comments update live over Socket.IO.

repos.name: Account-Managment-API
repos.description: Account and user services split into Spring Boot microservices, with Eureka discovery, a JWT gateway, RabbitMQ and Docker Compose.
